terminal_scope: This packet is the only successor; no support project is required.

identities.consumer: vLLM online FP8: --quantization fp8; dtype bfloat16; one CUDA L40S

direct_arm.placement: one nvidia-l40s, 48 GB, SM89, CUDA, single PCIe device
direct_arm.lifecycle: existing proven sequential Nebius owner used by campaign; retain one owner and cleanup watchdog
direct_arm.workload: text-only non-reasoning; primary 4214 input/358 output centered workload, then one 10K single-stream comparator
direct_arm.first_request_gate: health, complete request, output is non-empty and not degenerate repetition; capture raw response before any score
direct_arm.quality_boundary: FP8 is not production-eligible until exact raw outputs pass the campaign quality/feature gate; third-party FP8 throughput is not evidence.

economics.formula: throughput_l40s / throughput_h100 > rate_l40s / rate_h100; overhead, replicas, failures, and cache are added only after measurement
economics.cache_claim: not measured; no cache savings claimed

risk_evidence.official_runtime_route: vLLM exposes fp8 online quantization and the pinned Gemma4 image/source is content-bound.
risk_evidence.current_first_party_warning: vLLM issue #39049 reports Gemma4 dynamic FP8 gibberish output; issue #39407 reports FP8_BLOCK scale double-application. These are reasons to make the first CUDA request a correctness falsifier, not reasons to transfer quality or silently promote.
